## Release — backlog-campaign v0.37.3

### ✨ What's new in v0.37.3

#### Changes

- refactor(hooks): remove every blocking PreToolUse guard from every harness build. Claude Code auto mode is the gate; the risks the guards covered map to non-hook gates (ADR-065, supersedes ADR-061 and ADR-064). The marketplace bundle keeps only the SessionStart plugin-root export. Slice 1 of #1644.

#### Upgrade note

- Installed copies keep the old hooks until the plugin is updated or reinstalled: the plugin cache is keyed by version, so run `/plugin marketplace update` and reinstall `blackhole` (or clear `~/.claude/plugins/cache` and restart Claude Code) to drop the guards from an existing installation.
